result.rationale: Line: `const isTeamAdminOrOwner = (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...));` — the variable name and gate semantics imply OR, but `&&` requires the user to be both admin AND owner, so non-owner team admins get FORBIDDEN when they should be allowed. This is a verifiable logic defect introduced in the new handler.
